hash_scheme: salted-v2: each fingerprint is sha256 of canonical JSON {"data": ..., "salt": s}, where s = HMAC-SHA256(owner key, "nugget-record-salt|" + date). Without the salt the values behind a fingerprint cannot be guessed; the owner can reveal one day's salt (scripts/reveal_salt.py) to let anyone check that day against the decrypted statement.
